intro: This is The Woodlands in Rough Hollow, not the one up north. It is a wooded section of Lakeway where trees shape every window job, and CleanzATX plans extra time for screens and tracks.

paragraphs: The Woodlands is a wooded section of Rough Hollow, with homes priced around $800K to $1.3M. There is no gate, and the Rough Hollow HOA is the association here. Trees are the main feature, and many houses sit close to mature oaks and cedar.

The tree cover filters the light. Windows are often shaded, front porches are cool and the yard feels private. Those same trees drop leaves, pollen and twigs onto roofs, gutters and window frames. A shaded lot also keeps morning dew on the glass longer than an open one.

Under heavy cover the biggest issue is debris. Gutters fill with leaves, and tracks collect twigs and old pollen. In cedar season, from December to February, yellow dust coats everything, followed by oak pollen in March and April.

Spiders thrive in the shade, and cobwebs build up in window corners and under eaves. Mildew shows up as dark streaks on sills. Our pure water leaves glass clean, and a brush pass takes the webs and green growth off frames first.

We start with the webs and debris, then wash the glass with poles from the ground. Screens come down and get cleaned at $5 each. If gutters are full we can clean them too, priced per foot by the number of stories. The Woodlands pairs with Cypress Ridge for routing.

A 3,000 sq ft home is about $300 for exterior windows and takes around two hours outside. Interior glass adds an hour and a half or so. Tree heavy homes do well on a Triannual plan, with 15% off and a free yearly screen clean.

why: Webs, twigs and mildew cleared from frames before the glass
Screens and tracks treated as a core part of the visit
Gutters can be cleaned in the same trip

faq.q: Is this the same as The Woodlands north of Austin?
faq.a: No. This is a section inside Rough Hollow in Lakeway, 78738. There is no connection to any other place with that name.

faq.q: Why do my tracks stay dirty even after I wipe them?
faq.a: Pollen and fine leaf dust pack into the grooves and stick when damp. We clean tracks at $5 each with brushes and a wipe.
Yes. One story is $1.50 a foot, two stories $2.25 and three stories $3.25. It is a good add on for tree heavy lots.

faq.q: Can mildew on sills be removed?
faq.a: Usually, with a gentle wash. We use soft wash methods, never harsh pressure, so frames and finishes are not damaged.
